negative_snippets:
My experience at the hotel (booked via agoda) was avg. The hotel is highly rated but honestly I couldn't find a reason to rate it higher. Initially I was given room at lower floor which had no tv and broken chair. It was changed to a different room.

Changed room felt like below

Room: twin bed room with very basic amenities, linen seemed to be not so clean, had some stains nothing big though. Even the towels felt just cleaned not dry cleaned for sure. No tea or coffee setup

Staff: okish, I guess English was a problem.

Food: I had my food outside so can't comment on the food. Although I ordered tea it was on milkier side (I like strong tea)

Parking: very limited parking on site, although you can park on the road at your own risk

Checkin: was smooth though

Checkout: was smooth, for some reason I got an SMS stating pending amount of my stay which is weird as the booking was already paid by agoda.

Not sure if renovations are happening, it's a budget stay but I think you can get better deal at other places.

Lot of noise of cars and bikes since it's a residential area connected to main road

Bathroom smell so bad, towel given dirty, dirty slippers given, used lotion bottle, TV not working, room not clean, no hot water, basically charging money for nothing, and yes door lock not working, keep your luggage in the room at your own risk, food price so high taste is 0, outside food not allowed. Not recommended

I waited with this review to compare to other budget hotels, unfortunately this was the worst by far. The only good thing is that the room looked like on the pictures, although a little run down and the lighting was a bit too intense. The sheets had a couple holes. The AC was also really loud, but we didn‘t have high expectations for the price anyways.

The main issue is that there were cockroaches everywhere in the room. Not like one or two randomly but lots and at one point three of them were in my bag. It was very hard to be relaxed with them crawling around all the time.

The owner was nice and organized but didn‘t really act on the services requested, in the end we didn‘t get any of the promised toilet paper.

For the price the room would have been fine, but unfortunately the bugs ruined it.
